visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Zun stands in a well-lit room featuring a shelf packed with various plush toys and collectibles. He excitedly holds two black YouTube award boxes. He wears a white t-shirt with a blue graphic. The lighting is warm and bright, typical of an indoor home studio. (2) He opens the boxes to reveal the YouTube buttons. He performs a side-by-side comparison of a new, smaller silver button with a previous version. He uses exaggerated facial expressions and hand gestures to emphasize the size difference. (3) A brief animated overlay appears over his face, referencing Detective Conan. He then holds a gold YouTube award and an older, larger gold button, comparing their physical build and weight by handling them and showing them to the camera. (4) Zun places all three generations of YouTube awards—the old 100k button, the new 100k button, and the million-subscriber award—onto his display shelf alongside his toy collection. He ends with a satisfied pose, pointing towards the finished display.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration begins immediately with an upbeat electronic BGM track. A 'whoosh' SFX accompanies the first visual cut. Vocal pitch is high and delivery is rapid. (2) The sound of cardboard boxes being handled and plastic rustling is audible alongside the narration. A 'ding' SFX signals a comparison point. The BGM maintains a steady, driving tempo. (3) A percussive 'thud' sound is heard as the speaker taps a metal award frame against a surface to demonstrate its weight. The vocal tone becomes more comedic and descriptive. (4) Another 'whoosh' transition leads to the million-subscriber award unboxing. The speaker's arousal level increases, with louder vocal projection and higher pitch. (5) The video concludes with the BGM swelling in volume as the speaker finishes his thought. A final comic SFX sound effect plays at the very end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase and compare three generations of YouTube subscriber awards (100k and 1M) received by the creator, highlighting changes in design, size, and material quality over time while celebrating the milestone.
